name: Liberty Storage Header Pipeline
researcher_notes: This is an older line that was never captured, not a new announcement. The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects table for August 2026 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 421) lists the Liberty Storage Pipeline for Liberty Gas Storage LLC. It is a completed lateral, in service December 2006, in Louisiana, under Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP05-94. It shows 23 miles, 30 inch diameter, 1,000 million cubic feet per day and a cost of 30 million dollars. The length is about 37 km, above the 25 km threshold. The sponsor is Liberty Gas Storage LLC, owned 75 percent by a Sempra unit and 25 percent by ProLiance. An Oil and Gas Journal story from September 2005 confirms the storage site in Calcasieu Parish near Sulphur, but it gives no pipeline length, so it is not listed as a source for any value. Search results quoting the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission environmental assessment describe a 23.3 mile, 30 inch line from the compressor station to interconnects with Florida Gas Transmission and Tennessee Gas Pipeline in Calcasieu and Beauregard Parishes. I could not open that document to verify it, so it is not cited. Only one dated Energy Information Administration release supports the values, so the tier is medium and not independent. Current operating status was not confirmed beyond the 2006 in-service entry. No row for it exists in the tracker under this or any similar name (checked the existing roster for Liberty, Cameron, Calcasieu, Hackberry, storage and header). The consolidator note that it flows both ways fits a storage header, but no source states it. No route was found. Owner spelling matches the gazetteer style as written. Start and end locations (compressor station near Sulphur and the pipeline interconnects) need a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filing to cite.
